title: Intake
description: How inbox documents are scoped, grouped, classified and routed into concepts: each class can send its documents to a different concept type. Prose fields are applied by agents.

concept_type.description: The default concept type inbox documents become; a class's own concept_type overrides it. Required unless every class names one.

scope.description: When a document is in scope. An out-of-scope document is quarantined, not authored.

grouping.description: Which documents describe one concept and are authored together.

naming.description: How the concept's title is chosen.

concept_type.description: The concept type this class's documents become (overrides the intake default).

mode.description: With no existing concept: create it fully, or create it with only the routed sections (`partial`). `enrich-only` is read as `partial` (ADR 0011: no document waits for another). `extract`: the document is split into verbatim topic extracts before planning (ADR 0006); the class names no concept_type or sections.

extract.description: Required with mode `extract`: which passages are worth keeping, and what one extract covers (ADR 0006).
